autotroph-data.description: Autotroph Verified Data & Compliance MCP — schema-verified, zero-proxy APIs for SEC EDGAR XBRL financials (deduplicated 10-K/10-Q, derived Q4 & TTM, Assets = Liabilities + Equity check), EU TED eForms procurement tenders, USAspending/SAM.gov federal contracts, USPTO/EP/WO/JP/CN patent claim trees, and US Federal Register CFR rules. Runs remotely on Apify MCP (https://mcp.apify.com) with nominal $0.00005 start fee + $0.004-$0.01/record; free Apify accounts include $5/mo credit (~1,000+ calls). Get a free token at https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations?createApiToken=true&for=MCP.
